{{Top}}
A '''holojournalist''', one of several occupations in [[holojournalism]], was an individual who reported [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] news and stories on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Holojournalists are similar to real life [[Wikipedia:Journalist|journalists]] or news anchors.
